title: Trick or Treat x Blank the Spire
author: unwittingyeti
selftext:
Happy Halloween all you spooky bots and gamers!  


Blank the Spire is THE ~~only~~ premiere custom Slay the Spire 2 class generating website on earth and because it's 2026 and we get everything we ask for I have both a trick and a treat for you all:  
  
I’ll start with the treat: **every new account created this weekend will start with a Forge Token.**  
  
Sign up for a new account at [https://blankthespire.com/](https://blankthespire.com/) and you’ll start with a token 🎃🍬

When I first started this mod I thought I was going to host every custom call for free. The estimated cost of the first Forge ever was over ten dollars so that wasn’t going to work out great (I was calling Anthropic API endpoints at the time which are exclusively for rich mustachioed business tycoons ig)... having you all forging for the last few weeks has helped immensely in figuring out how to make things more efficient so that now \*most\* Forges are under a dollar in cost for me with a few in the high 70 cent range! I could have made almost thirty cents!! Can’t wait to grow out my moustache and shop for my first monocle!  
  
You think I forgot about the Trick I promised you? No way, Jorge. The trick I used to stabilize these creative forges is called JEV.  
  
When I first started on the creative harness, I would pass a big list of game mechanics to the bots and say ‘based on the description of the card, pick a game mechanic from this list to build the card around’. This caused a bunch of problems like how the LLM will tend to choose the first thing in the list. I randomized the list, then did the call in triplicate and then had another agent judge and compare the outputs and then I had a snail mail letter delivered to your grandma with a form to fill out to get her input in 4-9 business weeks.  
  
TOO MANY AGENTS.  
  
Now instead I have JEV run through each game mechanic and instead say something like ‘does this game mechanic fit this card thematically?’ JEV comes back with a confidence, then after a few more steps the prompt that actually gets sent to the llm is already \*much\* more focused.   
  
This also allowed me to add many many more entries to the game mechanics list, while still keeping the prompt to the card designer digestible.  
  
 👻 I hope you all have a fabulous Halloween! 👻 and, as always, thank you to everyone who has tried out Blank the Spire!
